---
title: "Style Guide"
description: "Every element the Blueprint theme styles, on one page."
---

This page exists to exercise the theme in `styles/`. Toggle light/dark with the
switch in the navbar — the same rules serve both, driven by the `--bp-*`
custom properties each palette file defines.

## Type scale

Body copy is Inter at 17px with a 1.65 line height. Headings are Fraunces, a
variable serif; the `SOFT`, `WONK` and `opsz` axes are set per level, which is
why the page title has more character than the section heads. Labels, dates and
code use JetBrains Mono.

### Third-level heading

Inline `code spans` sit in a hairline box, and [links draw their underline as a
background gradient](https://quarto.org) so it can thicken on hover without
moving the baseline.

> Blockquotes are set as margin notes: italic Fraunces against an orange rule.

## Section numbering

The `§01`, `§02` markers to the left of each `h2` come from a CSS counter, not
from the Markdown. Nothing in a `.qmd` file has to know its own number, and the
table of contents stays clean because the numbers live in a `::before`.

## Cards and tags

::: {.bp-grid}
::: {}
### Auto-fit grid
`::: {.bp-grid}` lays children out at a 210px minimum and lifts them on hover.
:::

::: {}
### Index cards
Listing pages get the same treatment through `.quarto-post`.
:::

::: {}
### Tags
`[text]{.bp-tag}` renders a small monospace label.
:::
:::

[spatial]{.bp-tag} [census]{.bp-tag} [policy]{.bp-tag}

## Code and output

Code blocks carry a green left rule; printed output gets a recessed strip
underneath, so input and output read as two different things.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
grid <- expand.grid(x = 1:3, y = 1:3)
grid$dist <- round(sqrt(grid$x^2 + grid$y^2), 2)
head(grid, 4)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  x y dist
1 1 1 1.41
2 2 1 2.24
3 3 1 3.16
4 1 2 2.24
```


:::
:::

## Callouts

::: {.callout-note}
Callout titles are set in monospace small caps, squared off to match the
drafting look.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
Border radius across the whole theme is 2px — a drawing has corners, not
rounded pills.
:::

## Where things live

- `styles/blueprint-light.scss` — paper palette and Bootstrap variables
- `styles/blueprint-dark.scss` — cyanotype palette, same variable names
- `styles/blueprint-rules.scss` — every rule, shared by both modes
- `styles/fonts.html` — the three typefaces, pulled in via `include-in-header`
